I answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random. **The ticket is #88412.**

- **Where it came from:** Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing when scanning the bill of lading (BOL) barcode. He first called the account "TP", then confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel.
- **Possible mix-up:** I also pointed out that #8841 is a different ticket. Tobias mentioned it in #central-random yesterday, for West yard Door 2 double-booking.
- **Visibility:** Hollis is a member of #central-team. Ticket numbers count as operational facts, not finance figures, so they were fine to share in #central-random. I didn't use `search_messages`.
